# Eco-conscious buyers

Buyers in both markets, skewing 25–40 and female, who check material composition, recycled content and repair options before purchasing. They respond to GRS certificates, resoling service and honest claims; they punish vague "eco-friendly" wording, which is why the green claims policy exists. Typical queries: "recycled fleece", "resoleable hiking boots", "pile riciclato". Relevant lines: Bosco, Rifugio, Dolomiti (resoling).
